newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Breweries higher after Foster's announcement.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Breweries higher after Foster's announcement.

text.p: Shares of Asahi Breweries Ltd rose in active trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Friday morning, following Australia's Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's FBG AX announcement that it would buy back its own shares from Asahi.
By 0013 GMT, Asahi shares were up 40 yen at 1,700.
It was the fifth most actively traded shares on the first section of TSE.
By 0054 GMT, Asahi had risen 100 yen, or around six percent, to 1,760, advancing to the position of fourth largest percentage gainer on the first section of the TSE.
Foster's said on Thursday that it would buy back 254.5 million of its shares from Asahi Breweries for A$625 million.

An Asahi spokesman also said on Thursday that an Asahi unit in Australia currently had a stake of 270 million shares, or 13.8 percent, in Foster's, of which it would sell 254 million shares at Foster's request.
